license: Apache-2.0 (Kokoro base voices for the original timbre) + MIT (Chatterbox performance). mr-pop and mr-pop-2 are original MRR Pop voices, not cloned from any person (mr-pop-2 is bootstrapped from mr-pop's own audio). mr-pop-3 and mr-pop-4 (the signature since 2026-11-14) use real human timbres provided by Vaibhav; see each voice's consent note.
sample: Wait. One developer, one browser extension, twelve thousand dollars a month? That's a pop! Here's how they did it.

voices.name: Mr. Pop (smooth)
voices.role: THE voice of Mr. Pop — every Reel (signature since 2026-11-14)

voices.notes: timbre.wav = 12 s clip (49.5-61.5 s) of the reference picked by human.py ref. reference.wav + emotions/*.wav = mr-pop-2's own reference and emotion clips re-voiced into that timbre (human.py build mr-pop-2 -> mr-pop-4), so expressive.py --ref mr-pop-4 keeps the signature accent/delivery. Speaker similarity to the reference 0.86, to the signature 0.85 (pure VC of the reference: 0.71).

delivery._about: Kokoro delivery styles — used only to rebuild Mr. Pop's timbre reference (voices/custom/mr-pop/reference.wav).

hook.use: First line. Big, bright, a little breathless.

curious.use: Questions and set-ups. Slower, leaning in — end on ? or …

trust.use: Numbers, sources, evidence labels. Steady and warm, no hype.

cta.use: End card: question + Follow MRR Pop.

expressive._about: Per-beat styles for expressive.py (Chatterbox). exaggeration = emotion/pitch range; cfg lower = slower, more deliberate; temperature = take variation; pause = seconds after the beat. emotion = which voices/custom/<voice>/emotions/<name>.wav reference performs the line (same voice, that emotion first).

wow.use: One-word peaks: Boom. Wow. Let's go! Highest pitch + energy.

signature.approved: 2026-11-14 — Vaibhav made Mr. Pop (smooth), voices/custom/mr-pop-4, the default: signature accent + delivery (mr-pop-2 reference + emotions re-voiced by human.py build) in the smooth timbre of his Lucknow_Sitapur_Road_3 reference. Seed 7, 6 takes, voice-match take picking unchanged. Previous signature: mr-pop-2 (kept).
signature._about: LOCKED: the approved Mr. Pop voice. expressive.py uses these defaults. Changing the 'expressive' styles, the seed or reference.wav changes how he sounds.
